page.overview:
Who is New Cell?

The New Cell, always referred to as just Cell, is a Bio-Android created by Dr. Gero during the Tournament of Time. He was created from the same bio-essence as his original counterpart, with the addition of new sources including Captain Ginyu, Frost, Nappa, Cabba and Shallot.

The new Cell is identical to the previous Cell.

New Cell is arrogant, considering himself far superior to the original Cell. He is also shown to be willing to take dangerous risks in order to achieve greater levels of power, which is shown when he admitted that his plan to use the Super Cell Games to achieve his Super Perfect Form was risky as there was no guarantee that he would survive.

Like the original Cell, he sees himself as superior to others to the point he treats them as little more than playthings. Even his own allies don't mean anything to him and he has no problem killing Cooler for attempting to blow up the Earth, as it would end his "games" too early. However before acquiring his perfect form, he is willing to work with Dabura (and by extension the Organization of Babidi) especially after the King of Demon Realm assists him in absorbing Android 18 and agrees to host the Super Cell Games as a way to pay his debt to Dabura, even though New Cell has his own reasons for hosting the games.
